cards.headline: Diagonal haptic capture of an acrylic intraocular lens: long-term safety and efficacy

source.title: Diagonal haptic capture of an acrylic intraocular lens: long-term safety and efficacy.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: DHC of a 4-haptic hydrophilic acrylic IOL provided stable long-term fixation, satisfactory visual and refractive outcomes, and a low incidence of complications. However, these results may be IOL-specific.

cards.headline: TELEMANIPULATED ROBOT-ASSISTED VITREORETINAL SURGERY

source.title: TELEMANIPULATED ROBOT-ASSISTED VITREORETINAL SURGERY: Safety and Effectiveness of the Luca System in Robotically Performed Core Vitrectomy in ERM or Macular Hole Surgical Treatment.
source.excerpt: The initial clinical experience with the Luca robotic system demonstrates a favorable safety, feasibility, and performance profile for vitreoretinal surgery in patients with acquired maculopathies. The safety profile seems comparable with that of manual surgery.

cards.headline: Preloaded vs manually loaded intraocular lens delivery failure modes

source.title: Preloaded vs manually loaded intraocular lens delivery failure modes: analysis of U.S. Food and Drug Administration device reports.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: Preloaded and manually loaded IOL delivery systems demonstrated distinct failure-mode profiles within FDA device reports. These findings characterized reporting patterns rather than population-level risk and may inform device design and postmarket surveillance priorities.

source.title: ASSOCIATION OF METABOLIC SYNDROME AND ITS COMPONENTS WITH RETINAL ARTERY OCCLUSION: An Epidemiologic and Genetic Analysis.
source.excerpt: Metabolic syndrome, especially its key components hypertension and hyperglycemia, increased the risk of RAO onset. Genetic susceptibility to type 2 diabetes mellitus also increased RAO risk in patients with MetS.

source.excerpt: Most included studies remained at internal validation stages, and prospective multicenter evaluation was rare. Because 122/361 reports sought for retrieval were unavailable and most were considered plausibly eligible, retrieval bias may affect the comprehensiveness of the evidence map.

source.excerpt: However, future research should prioritize standardized evaluation frameworks, explainable AI, external validation across diverse healthcare systems, and economic assessment to support the responsible and scalable deployment of AI-enabled fraud detection systems.

Fluorescein angiography is a valuable adjunct for detecting occult neovascularization and guiding timely surgical intervention when visualization is limited.

cards.headline: Monovision vs blended vision for presbyopia correction: prospective observational study

source.title: Monovision vs blended vision for presbyopia correction: prospective observational study.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: Blended vision provides superior continuous range of vision, better quality of life, enhanced spectacle independence, and preserved stereoacuity compared with monovision, though at the cost of increased dysphotopsia and reduced contrast sensitivity.

source.title: PERIPHERAL DEGENERATIVE RETINOSCHISIS: Imaging Evidence for Two Distinct Structural Configurations.
source.excerpt: These findings support the distinction between columnar and bullous retinoschisis as separate morphologic entities. Although vitreous traction may contribute to initiation of retinoschisis, progression to bullous schisis may involve additional mechanisms.

cards.headline: Alexander Walterowitsch Litwinenko

source.title: Alexander Walterowitsch Litwinenko
source.excerpt: Alexander Walterowitsch Litwinenko war ein russischer und später britischer Nachrichtendienstler. Er war Offizier des sowjetischen Geheimdienstes KGB bzw. seines russischen Nachfolgers FSB und ab 2003 als Überläufer des britischen Auslandsgeheimdienstes MI6. Später trat er als Kritiker des russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin und Buchautor in Erscheinung.

cards.headline: Diejenigen von euch, die abberufen werden und Gattinnen hinterlassen …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:240
source.excerpt: والأزواج الذين يموتون ويتركون زوجات بعدهم، فعليهم وصيةً لهنَّ: أن يُمَتَّعن سنه تامة من يوم الوفاة، بالسكنى في منزل الزوج من غير إخراج الورثة لهن مدة السنة; جبرًا لخاطر الزوجة، وبرًا بالمتوفَّى. فإن خرجت الزوجات باختيارهن قبل انقضاء السنة فلا إثم عليكم -أيها الورثة- في ذلك، ولا حرج على الزوجات فيما فعلن في أنفسهن من أمور مباحة. والله عزيز في ملكه، حكيم في أمره ونهيه.

cards.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًا وَصِيَّةً لِّأَزْوَٰجِهِم مَّتَـٰعًا إِلَى ٱلْحَوْلِ غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍ ۚ فَإِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى مَا فَعَلْنَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ مِن مَّعْرُوفٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
cards.translation: Diejenigen von euch, die abberufen werden und Gattinnen hinterlassen, sollen ihren Gattinnen eine Abfindung für ein Jahr vermachen, ohne daß sie aus (dem Haus) gewiesen werden. Wenn sie aber ausziehen, so liegt für euch keine Sünde in dem, was sie mit sich selbst an Geziemendem unternehmen. Allah ist Allmächtig und Allweise.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Und den geschiedenen Frauen steht eine Abfindung in rechtlicher Weise zu - eine Pflicht …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:241
source.excerpt: وللمطلقات متاع من كسوة ونفقة على الوجه المعروف المستحسن شرعًا، حقًا على الذين يخافون الله ويتقونه في أمره ونهيه.

cards.arabic: وَلِلْمُطَلَّقَـٰتِ مَتَـٰعٌۢ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
cards.translation: Und den geschiedenen Frauen steht eine Abfindung in rechtlicher Weise zu - eine Pflicht für die Gottesfürchtigen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: ACUTE MACULAR NEURORETINOPATHY-LIKE LESIONS AS AN OCT-DEFINED PHENOTYPE

source.title: ACUTE MACULAR NEURORETINOPATHY-LIKE LESIONS AS AN OCT-DEFINED PHENOTYPE: A Spectrum from Ischemia to Inflammation.
source.excerpt: AMN-like lesions occurred in a broad range of ocular diseases. Lesion morphology and imaging features varied with the underlying conditions, supporting these lesions as an OCT phenotype rather than a single entity. Multimodal imaging and clinical context are essential for accurate interpretation.

cards.headline: INTRASCLERAL FIXATION WITH DOUBLE-FLANGED PROLENE

source.title: INTRASCLERAL FIXATION WITH DOUBLE-FLANGED PROLENE: A Stable Technique for Intraocular Lens Implantation.
source.excerpt: The DFP technique offers a safe, efficient alternative to YF for IOL fixation in eyes without capsular support, providing stable positioning, improved visual outcomes, and reduced endothelial cell loss.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy

source.title: Artificial intelligence in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy: a systematic review.
source.excerpt: The available studies suggest that AI may support the automation of selected workflow steps and assist treatment-related decision-making in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Critical Care Nephrology

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Critical Care Nephrology: Current Applications, Emerging Techniques, and Challenges to Clinical Integration.
source.excerpt: Realizing the promise of AI in CCN will require multidisciplinary collaboration, fairness and generalizability testing, and sustainable implementation strategies that align technologic innovation with measurable improvements in patient care.

cards.headline: Grossbrand von Schweizerhalle

source.title: Grossbrand von Schweizerhalle
source.excerpt: Der Grossbrand von Schweizerhalle ereignete sich am 1. November 1986 im Industriegebiet «Schweizerhalle» bei Basel in der Schweiz und löste eine Giftwelle im Rhein aus. Eine Lagerhalle des damaligen Chemiekonzerns Sandoz mit Chemikalien geriet in Brand.

cards.headline: OUTCOMES AND HEALING PROCESS OF RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIAL TEARS IN PATIENTS WITH AMD

source.title: OUTCOMES AND HEALING PROCESS OF RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIAL TEARS IN PATIENTS WITH AMD: A 5-Year Retrospective Observational Case Series.
source.excerpt: Approximately half of the eyes with RPE tears developed tear-associated retinal pigment epithelial proliferation, typically within the first year. Tear-associated retinal pigment epithelial proliferation did not confer a visual benefit. These findings suggest that anatomical remodeling of RPE tears may occur without translating into improved visual outcomes.

cards.headline: Corneal versus refractive surgically induced astigmatism

source.title: Corneal versus refractive surgically induced astigmatism: vector analysis of their dissociation and implications for toric IOL planning.
source.excerpt: Individually measured tSIA has only limited value for toric IOL planning.

cards.headline: The risk association between systemic lupus erythematosus and glaucoma

source.title: The risk association between systemic lupus erythematosus and glaucoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Existing evidence suggests that SLE may be associated with an increased risk of glaucoma. Given the limitations of this study, more prospective studies with rigorous design and full control of confounding factors are needed for further verification.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in fundus photography for type 2 diabetes

source.title: Artificial intelligence in fundus photography for type 2 diabetes: a scoping review of systemic biomarkers and multi-organ risk prediction.
source.excerpt: Most studies emphasized discrimination metrics without comprehensive evaluation of clinical utility.Retinal AI shows potential for scalable systemic risk surveillance in T2DM, but rigorous external validation, standardized reporting, and prospective implementation studies are required to enable safe and equitable clinical translation.

cards.headline: ANEMIA OF PREMATURITY

source.title: ANEMIA OF PREMATURITY: Risk Factor of Retinopathy of Prematurity in Later-Preterm and Heavier Birth-Weight Neonates.
source.excerpt: AOP is independently associated with retinopathy of prematurity across the spectrum of prematurity, including infants traditionally considered lower risk. Incorporating AOP into ROP risk stratification may help identify vulnerable infants who warrant closer ophthalmologic surveillance beyond current screening criteria.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Delirium Care

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Delirium Care: Predicting, Detecting, and Preventing Delirium in Older Hospitalized Adults.
source.excerpt: Established multicomponent non-pharmacological interventions remain the strongest evidence-based approach to prevention, while evidence that AI-triggered recommendations improve patient outcomes is limited.

cards.headline: Application of artificial intelligence in esophageal surgery: a systematic review

source.title: Application of artificial intelligence in esophageal surgery: a systematic review.
source.excerpt: To ensure clinical applicability, future research should focus on large-scale validation and prospective clinical trials to establish artificial intelligence's clinical utility and safety in minimally invasive esophagectomy.

cards.headline: RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIUM DEFECTS, SEALED AND UNSEALED

source.title: RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIUM DEFECTS, SEALED AND UNSEALED: A Lifecycle and Disease Agnostic Terminology.
source.excerpt: RPE defects beneath a disrupted photoreceptor layer may become "sealed" by reactive Müller cell gliosis, preventing the occurrence of SRF. Retinal pigment epithelium defects with intact photoreceptors remain "unsealed," resulting in SRF accumulation.

cards.headline: Efficacy and safety of obinutuzumab in refractory membranous nephropathy

source.title: Efficacy and safety of obinutuzumab in refractory membranous nephropathy: a single-arm meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Obinutuzumab demonstrates marked efficacy in treating refractory MN, with an overall clinical remission rate of 86% and a low incidence of severe adverse events. This profile signifies a potential therapeutic role for this condition. However, all raw data included in this meta-analysis were derived from uncontrolled retrospective single-arm trials and case series.

cards.headline: So macht Allah euch Seine Zeichen klar, auf daß ihr begreifen möget.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:242
source.excerpt: مثل ذلك البيان الواضح في أحكام الأولاد والنساء، يبيِّن الله لكم آياته وأحكامه في كل ما تحتاجونه في معاشكم ومعادكم; لكي تعقلوها وتعملوا بها.

cards.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
cards.translation: So macht Allah euch Seine Zeichen klar, auf daß ihr begreifen möget.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Siehst du nicht jene, die, um dem Tod zu entfliehen …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:243
source.excerpt: ألم تعلم -أيها الرسول- قصة الذين فرُّوا من أرضهم ومنازلهم، وهم ألوف كثيرة; خشية الموت من الطاعون أو القتال، فقال لهم الله: موتوا، فماتوا دفعة واحدة عقوبة على فرارهم من قدر الله، ثم أحياهم الله تعالى بعد مدة; ليستوفوا آجالهم، وليتعظوا ويتوبوا؟ إن الله لذو فضل عظيم على الناس بنعمه الكثيرة، ولكن أكثر الناس لا يشكرون فضل الله عليهم.

cards.arabic: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ وَهُمْ أُلُوفٌ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مُوتُوا۟ ثُمَّ أَحْيَـٰهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
cards.translation: Siehst du nicht jene, die, um dem Tod zu entfliehen, zu Tausenden aus ihren Wohnstätten hinauszogen? Da sagte Allah zu ihnen: „Sterbt! Hierauf machte Er sie wieder lebendig. Allah ist wahrlich voll Huld gegen die Menschen. Aber die meisten Menschen sind nicht dankbar.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Story of the Dead People: Ibn Abu Hatim related that Ibn `Abbas said that these people mentioned herein, were the residents of a village called Dawardan. `Ali bin `Asim said that they were from Dawardan, a village several miles away from Wasit (in Iraq).

cards.headline: VISUALIZING VASCULAR EFFECTS OF SELECTIVE SEROTONIN REUPTAKE INHIBITORS

source.title: VISUALIZING VASCULAR EFFECTS OF SELECTIVE SEROTONIN REUPTAKE INHIBITORS: An OCT Angiography Perspective.
source.excerpt: Chronic use of SSRIs has been associated with measurable reductions in retinal vascular density and enlargement of the FAZ, which may reflect microvascular compromise. Escitalopram seems to demonstrate a more pronounced vascular effect in comparison with other SSRIs. These findings highlight the significance of retinal vascular evaluation in patients undergoing long-term SSRI therapy.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in the diagnosis and identification of bacterial pathogens

source.title: Artificial intelligence in the diagnosis and identification of bacterial pathogens: Current advances and future perspectives.
source.excerpt: In the future, AI-integrated microbiology laboratories, rapid diagnostic platforms, genomic surveillance systems, and AI-assisted clinical decision support tools are expected to further enhance infectious disease diagnostics and contribute to improved antimicrobial stewardship and global infection management.

cards.headline: Non-Invasive and AI-Enabled Diagnostic Approaches for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome

source.title: Non-Invasive and AI-Enabled Diagnostic Approaches for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: A PRISMA-Guided Narrative Review.
source.excerpt: The evidence projects a diagnostic shift toward reproducible, multimodal, and phenotype-sensitive PCOS detection. Integration of AI-based pipelines when integrated with imaging morphology, hormonal data, and metabolic markers offers significant opportunities for equitable, early-stage identification across diverse healthcare settings.

cards.headline: POLARIMETRIC ENTROPY IN HYPOAUTOFLUORESCENT LESIONS OF CENTRAL SEROUS CHORIORETINOPATHY

source.title: POLARIMETRIC ENTROPY IN HYPOAUTOFLUORESCENT LESIONS OF CENTRAL SEROUS CHORIORETINOPATHY: Association With Simple/Complex Classification.
source.excerpt: Polarimetric entropy identifies almost all NIRAF-dark lesions and provides a retinal pigment epithelial layer‑specific, melanin-related depolarization metric on a continuous scale. Complex CSC is characterized by broader involvement and greater PE loss, consistent with more severe retinal pigment epithelial dysfunction. PE may complement extent-based classification.

cards.headline: Risk factors for post-COVID-19 condition among previously hospitalized COVID-19 patients

source.title: Risk factors for post-COVID-19 condition among previously hospitalized COVID-19 patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Among previously hospitalized COVID-19 patients, the most consistent risk factors for post-COVID outcomes were female sex, greater acute disease severity or respiratory support, ICU admission, no or incomplete vaccination, and hypertension.

cards.headline: Hyperspectral Imaging for Mycotoxin Monitoring in Food

source.title: Hyperspectral Imaging for Mycotoxin Monitoring in Food: A Comprehensive Review of Technologies, Algorithms, and Applications.
source.excerpt: This review concludes by identifying critical research gaps and proposing strategic directions for translating HSI-based mycotoxin detection from laboratory proof-of-concept to routine industrial application.

cards.headline: Choroidal Thickness and Axial Length as Independent Correlates of AMD

source.title: Choroidal Thickness and Axial Length as Independent Correlates of AMD: Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017-2020.
source.excerpt: Greater SFCT and shorter AL were independently associated with early AMD. These findings suggest that choroidal thickness and axial length may reflect distinct structural correlates.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in acute stroke imaging

source.title: Artificial intelligence in acute stroke imaging: A comprehensive survey from imaging assessment to outcome prediction.
source.publisher: Computerized medical imaging and graphics : the official journal of the Computerized Medical Imaging Society
source.excerpt: This review offers practical guidance to develop fully operational AI systems that can be integrated into emergency stroke care.

cards.headline: Explainable AI in breast cancer ultrasound imaging: current developments and challenges

source.title: Explainable AI in breast cancer ultrasound imaging: current developments and challenges.
source.excerpt: Lastly, possible future pathways are outlined to close the gap between the currently successful AI systems and their successful application to clinical practice.

cards.headline: METASTATIC UROTHELIAL CARCINOMA OF THE BLADDER TO THE RETINA

source.title: METASTATIC UROTHELIAL CARCINOMA OF THE BLADDER TO THE RETINA: A CLINICOPATHOLOGIC CORRELATION AND REVIEW OF THE LITERATURE.
source.excerpt: We report the second documented case, to our knowledge, of retinal metastasis from UCB. The clinical pattern and presentation fit similarly to the first documented case.

cards.headline: Efficacy and safety of cadonilimab for malignant solid tumor treatment

source.title: Efficacy and safety of cadonilimab for malignant solid tumor treatment: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Cadonilimab demonstrates a positive response in the treatment of various solid tumors, exhibiting good tolerability.

cards.headline: Assessing the role of vitamin D in the prevention and management of chronic rhinosinusitis

source.title: Assessing the role of vitamin D in the prevention and management of chronic rhinosinusitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Vitamin D deficiency is strongly associated with increased disease severity and recurrence in CRS. Supplementation appears to provide clinical benefits and may serve as a promising adjunct to standard therapy. Further high-quality randomized controlled trials are required to establish optimal dosing strategies and inform clinical guideline recommendations.

cards.headline: Machine learning based prediction models for first stroke in community primary care

source.title: Machine learning based prediction models for first stroke in community primary care: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.publisher: BMC medical informatics and decision making
source.excerpt: Despite the increasing use of ML models for first-stroke risk prediction, their clinical utility in community primary healthcare remains unverified. Current ML models show no significant advantage over traditional regression methods and face challenges in algorithm innovation, data standardization, and external validation.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence models in the surgical planning of low-grade gliomas

source.title: Artificial intelligence models in the surgical planning of low-grade gliomas: a systematic review.
source.excerpt: AI/ML models have shown promising results in diagnostic and management approaches for glioma resection. Nonetheless, this is based on a small number of studies (n=8) and remain preliminary. Validating the findings in external datasets with a larger patient population would help enhance the predictive capacity of the existing models.

cards.headline: Und kämpft auf Allahs Weg und wißt, daß Allah Allhörend und Allwissend ist.

cards.headline: Wer ist es denn, der Allah ein schönes Darlehen gibt?

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:245
source.excerpt: من ذا الذي ينفق في سبيل الله إنفاقًا حسنًا احتسابًا للأجر، فيضاعفه له أضعافا كثيرة لا تحصى من الثواب وحسن الجزاء؟ والله يقبض ويبسط، فأنفقوا ولا تبالوا; فإنه هو الرزاق، يُضيِّق على مَن يشاء من عباده في الرزق، ويوسعه على آخرين، له الحكمة البالغة في ذلك، وإليه وحده ترجعون بعد الموت، فيجازيكم على أعمالكم.

cards.arabic: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥٓ أَضْعَافًا كَثِيرَةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَقْبِضُ وَيَبْصُۜطُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
cards.translation: Wer ist es denn, der Allah ein schönes Darlehen gibt? So vermehrt Er es ihm um ein Vielfaches. Allah hält zurück und gewährt, und zu Ihm werdet ihr zurückgebracht.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
